title: Servo Sweep
summary: Sweep a servo horn from 0 to 180 degrees and back.
learningObjectives: Attach a servo to a pin with Servo.attach().
Understand that angle comes from pulse width.
expectedBehavior: The servo horn sweeps 0 -> 180 -> 0 degrees continuously.
predictPrompt: How long does one full sweep take at 15 ms per degree?
observePrompt: Watch the horn. Does the motion match your estimate?
tryNext: Change the step delay to 5 ms and predict the new sweep time.
